translations.text: The oracle of the word of the Lord concerning Israel through his messenger.
Take this to heart: “I have loved you,” says the Lord. Yet you say, “How have you loved us?” “Was not Esau Jacob’s brother?” says the Lord. “Yet I loved Jacob,
and I hated Esau. I made his territory a place of destruction and his inheritance an allotment of the wilderness.

For if Edom says, ‘Look, we have been destroyed; let us return and rebuild the ruined cities,’ the Lord Almighty says this: ‘They will build, but I will tear down. They will be called the Territory of Lawlessness and the people against whom the Lord will wage war forever.’
Your eyes will see it, and you yourselves will say, ‘The Lord has been exalted over the territory of Israel.’

A son gives glory to his father, and a servant fears his master. Now, if I am a father, where is my glory? And if I am a master, where is my honor?” says the Lord Almighty. “You priests who speak contemptuously of my name say, ‘How have we spoken contemptuously of your name?’
Because you offer defiled bread on my altar. Yet you say, ‘How have we defiled them?’ By saying, ‘The Lord’s table is despised,’ and by despising whatever is placed on it.

If you offer a blind animal as a sacrifice, is that not evil? And if you offer a lame or sick animal, is that not evil? Go on, offer it to your governor! Will he accept you or show you favor?” says the Lord Almighty.
“Now plead before your God and appease him. This has come from your hands. Will I show any of you favor?” says the Lord Almighty.
“For the doors will be closed to you, and you must not approach my altar in vain. For I take no pleasure in you,” says the Lord Almighty, “and I will not accept sacrifices from your hands.

For from the rising of the sun to its setting, my name is glorified among the nations. In every place incense and a pure sacrifice are offered to my name, because my name is great among the Gentiles,” says the Lord Almighty.
“But you profane it by saying, ‘The Lord’s table is defiled, and the food placed on it is despised.’

You were saying, ‘That comes from hardship,’ and I will blow it away,” says the Lord Almighty. “And if you offer me what has been seized, and lame and feeble animals as a sacrifice, will I accept them from your hands?” says the Lord Almighty.

“Cursed be the man who has the means, has a male animal in his flock, and is bound by a vow, yet offers the Lord a blemished animal. For I am a victorious King,” says the Lord Almighty, “and my name is renowned among the nations.
And now this is my command to you priests.

If you do not listen and do not take to heart giving glory to my name,” says the Lord Almighty, “I will send a curse upon you and curse your blessings. I will curse it and scatter your blessings, and let it no longer remain among you, because you did not take it to heart.
Look, I will set apart the shoulder for you, and I will scatter dung over your faces, the dung of your festivals, and carry you away with it.
Then you will know that I sent you this command so that my covenant might be with the Levites,” says the Lord Almighty.
“My covenant with him was one of life and peace. I gave him fear, so that he would fear me and shrink back before my name.
The law of truth was in his mouth, and no injustice was found on his lips. He walked with me in peace and uprightness, and he turned many away from injustice.
For a priest’s lips should preserve knowledge, and people should seek the law from his mouth, because he is the messenger of the Lord Almighty.
But you have turned aside from the way, weakened many through the law, and corrupted the covenant of Levi,” says the Lord Almighty.
And I made you despised and rejected among all nations, because you did not keep my ways but showed partiality in applying the law.
Do you not all have one father? Did not one God establish you? Why does each of you abandon his brother, profaning the covenant of your fathers?
Judah was forsaken, and abominations were committed in Israel and Jerusalem, because Judah profaned the Lord’s holy things through those whom he loved and joined himself to foreign gods.
May the Lord destroy the man who does this, until he is brought low, removing him from the tents of Jacob and from those who offer sacrifices to the Lord Almighty.
And you did what I hated: you covered my altar with tears, with weeping and groans arising from hardships. Is it fitting for me to look again at your sacrifices or to accept anything from your hands?
And you say, “[?] Why?” Because the Lord established a covenant between you and the wife of your youth, whom you abandoned, though she was your spouse and the wife of your covenant.
And no one else made it, and it is a portion of his spirit. And you say, “What else does God seek but offspring?” Guard your spirits, and do not abandon the wife of your youth.
But if you send her away out of hatred, says the Lord God of Israel, wickedness will cover your thoughts, says the Lord Almighty. Guard yourselves in your spirits, and do not abandon her.

You provoke God with your words, and you say, “How have we provoked him?” By saying, “Everyone who does evil seems good before the Lord, and he takes pleasure in that very thing,” and, “Where is the God of justice?”

Look, I will send my messenger, and he will inspect my ways before me. And the Lord whom you seek will suddenly come to his temple, as will the messenger of the covenant whom you desire. Look, he is coming, says the Lord Almighty.
And who will endure the day of his coming? Or who will remain steadfast when he appears? For he will come like the flame of a smelting furnace and like soap used for washing.
And he will sit to melt and purify, as with silver and gold. He will purify the sons of Levi and refine them like gold and silver, and they will offer sacrifices to the Lord in righteousness.
And the sacrifice of Judah and Jerusalem will be pleasing to the Lord, as in the days of old and as in former years.

And I will come upon you in judgment, and I will be a swift witness against sorcerers and adulterous women, against those who swear falsely in my name, those who withhold a hired worker’s wages, those who oppress widows and strike orphans, those who pervert the rights of the foreign resident, and those who do not fear me, says the Lord Almighty.
For I am the Lord your God, and I do not change, and you are the sons of Jacob.

You have not turned away from the sins of your fathers. You have evaded my laws and have not kept them. Return to me, and I will return to you, says the Lord Almighty. And you say, “How shall we return?”
Can a person cheat God? Yet you have cheated me. And you say, “How have we cheated you?” Because the tithes and firstfruits are still with you.
And in your malice you act maliciously and cheat me.

The year came to an end, and you gathered all the produce into your storehouses, and your houses will be plundered. Return in this way, says the Lord Almighty, and see whether I will not open the windows of heaven for you and pour out my blessing upon you until it abounds.
And I will take care of your food, and I will not destroy the fruit of your land. Let your vine not fail in the vineyard, says the Lord Almighty.
And all nations will call you blessed, because you will be a desirable land to me, says the Lord Almighty.
You have burdened me with your words, says the Lord. And you say, “How have we spoken against you?”
Because you said, “Everyone who serves God does so in vain. And what benefit is there in having kept his requirements and having walked with supplications before the Lord Almighty?”
And now we call others blessed, and all who practice lawlessness prosper; they turned against God and survived.

Those who feared the Lord murmured these things, each to his companion. The Lord paid attention and heard, and he wrote a book of remembrance before those who feared the Lord and those who trembled at his name.
And they shall be mine, says the Lord Almighty, on the day when I bring about deliverance. I will cherish them as a father cherishes the son who serves him well.
And you shall return and see the difference between the righteous and the lawless, between one who serves God and one who does not serve him.

For behold, the day of the Lord shall come, blazing like a furnace, and it shall burn them. All foreigners and all who practice lawlessness shall be reeds, and the coming day shall set them ablaze, says the Lord Almighty. Neither root nor branch shall remain for them.
But for you who fear my name, the sun of righteousness shall rise, with healing in its wings. You shall go out and leap like calves released from their tethers.
And you shall trample the lawless, and they shall become ashes beneath your feet on the day that I bring about, says the Lord Almighty.
Remember the law of Moses my servant, all the commands and ordinances that I commanded him at Horeb.
And behold, I am sending you Elijah the Tishbite before the great and glorious day of the Lord comes,
who shall turn the heart of a father toward his son and the heart of a man toward his companion, lest I come and strike the earth utterly.
